other.tags: Lo-fi hip hop beat. A dusty, vinyl-crackling drum loop features a muffled kick and a crisp, slightly late snare. A Rhodes electric piano plays a repeating four-bar progression of jazzy seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect. A deep, rounded sine-wave synth bass follows the root notes of the piano. A subtle, high-pitched sine whistle melody enters periodically with heavy portamento. The track maintains a steady 85 BPM in the key of C minor. High-frequency content is rolled off with a low-pass filter to create a warm, vintage aesthetic. Occasional foley sounds of rain and distant city ambience are layered into the background.
other.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and rain foley]
[electric piano enters with jazzy chords]

[Main Section]
[muffled kick and snare drum loop enters]
[sub bass follows piano root notes]
[high-pitched sine synth with portamento plays occasional melodic accents]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[electric piano fades out]
[rain foley and vinyl crackle continue to silence]

bass.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a chromatic descending pattern. The bass guitar follows the guitar line with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a fast d-beat pattern with constant eighth-note hits on a closed hi-hat and a high-tuned, resonant snare. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The recording has a lo-fi, DIY aesthetic with prominent room reverb on the drum kit. 180 BPM. Key of E minor. 4/4 time signature.
bass.prompt:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, d-beat drum pattern]

[Verse 1]
[shouted male vocals]
Systematic lies [crash cymbal]
Feeding on the weak
Broken promises
The future's looking bleak [guitar feedback]

[Chorus]
[bass guitar distortion increases]
No way out! (No way out!)
No way out! (No way out!)
[snare rolls]

[Outro]
[guitar chugging on low E string]
[final crash cymbal]

vocals.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play a palm-muted, syncopated riff in E minor. The bass guitar follows the guitar riff with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums feature a double-kick pedal pattern with rapid sixteenth-note bursts and a bright, cutting snare. A wah-filtered lead guitar performs a fast, blues-scale solo with wide vibrato and rapid alternate picking. The tempo is 140 BPM in 4/4 time. High-gain amplification and room reverb are applied to the entire mix.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar riff, palm-muted]
[bass guitar enters, doubling the riff]
[drums enter with crash cymbal and double-kick pedal]
